comment: I loved taking Animal Minds course. Prof. Misha made lectures easy and interesting to understand. She genuinely care about students progress and make sure everyone gets opportunity to express. I got to learn many new and interesting studies about animal research. I highly recommend taking this course.

The lectures were full of interactive discussions, engaging videos, and interesting case studies. Dr. Mishra uses real-life examples and anecdotes that makes the material relatable and easy to understand. She encourage to participate in class discussion. The fun part is zoo trip which helps to appreciate the learning in natural setting.

Animal mind course was fun! Be prepared to watch lots of cool animal videos and learn cool experiments about animal cognition. Prof. Mishra tries to keep the course interesting and fun with assignments and class activities. Grading was generous, lectures were clear, reading the chapters before the class definitely helps.

Professor Mishra is extremely unclear with what she expects for the class and how you can achieve good grades, her assignments often do not relate to class topics study and she seems to lack the understanding of what students need out of a class. Her quizzes are extremely specific and difficult and her marking does not make much sense.
